description: Lists event types associated with a specified user or organization, with filtering and pagination. Use scheduling_url from results directly rather than constructing event type URLs.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing event types for a user or organization.

active.description: Filter by active status. Return only active event types if true, only inactive if false, or all event types if omitted.
active.title: Active

admin_managed.description: Filter by admin management status. True for admin-managed only, false to exclude admin-managed, or omitted to include all.
admin_managed.title: Admin Managed

organization.description: URI of the organization whose event types to list. Exactly one of 'organization' or 'user' must be provided (mutually exclusive).
organization.title: Organization

page_token.description: Pagination token for retrieving subsequent pages. Check pagination.next_page_token in the response; if non-null, pass it as page_token in the next call. Repeat until next_page_token is null.
page_token.title: Page Token

sort.description: Order results by field(s) and direction. Accepts comma-separated list of field:direction values (e.g., 'name:asc,created_at:desc'). Default: name:asc
sort.title: Sort

user.description: URI of the user whose event types to list. Exactly one of 'user' or 'organization' must be provided (mutually exclusive).
user.title: User

user_availability_schedule.description: URI of the user's availability schedule. Used with 'user' parameter to filter event types by primary availability schedule.
user_availability_schedule.title: User Availability Schedule
